question: Do regions with lower initial mean years of schooling gain more across cohorts (regional convergence)?
estimand: Spearman rho of dMYS vs MYS_initial across 17 regions (sex-aggregated mean of two sex rows)
threshold: CONVERGENCE if rho<0 AND >=12/17 regions have dMYS>0
label: derived
note: regions with dMYS>0: 17/17; sex rows aggregated by mean (n_sex_rows reported per region). LIMITATION: regional tertiary enrolment is NOT observed on disk; there is no PHL regional tertiary GER/participation series. All cells use regional attainment/inequality proxies and national tertiary GER as CONTEXT ONLY. No causal or policy-effect claim. Cohort comparison is descriptive.

question: Did regional education inequality fall, and did it fall more where initial inequality was higher?

threshold: EQUALIZING if dGini<=-0.02 in >=10/17 regions AND rho(dGini, initial)<0
label: derived
